subject.event: Self-reported elevated stress in the coming week
subject.outcomeDefinition: The user records stress >= 4 (on the 1-5 DailyCheckIn scale) on at least 3 of the 7 daily check-ins dated 2026-06-15 through 2026-06-21.
subject.resolutionSource: DailyCheckIn.stress rows for this user, which are user-entered and are not produced by the risk engine.

interval.method: Wilson interval on the user's own 28-day base rate, widened for the smoothing lag

baseline.source: This user's own trailing 28-day check-in history
baseline.basis: Proportion of trailing 7-day windows in the last 28 days containing at least 3 days at stress >= 4: 10 of 28 windows.

sampleSize.basis: The engine's full baseline window for this user. Personal baselines exist for 5 of 5 metrics (MIN_BASELINE_DAYS is 7).

knownGaps: Exercise dimension inactive; the user has logged no exercise records.

outliers.handling: One day of 14 logged work hours during a release was retained; it is a genuine workload spike of the kind this prediction is about, not a data error.

regime.description: No change in the user's declared work schedule, expected weekly hours, or tracked integrations during the window.

market.reason: No market, exchange, or external reference expectation exists for an individual's self-reported stress. Nothing prices this outcome.
